text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
F-la-sh-san-♪ It's your birthday today, 
isn't it? Happy birthday!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I intend to dedicate 
myself anew for another year. And manage 
my schedule even more meticulously.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then let's plan to go eat cake♪ This 
coming weekend, at the German cake cafe 
past the station♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
One moment, please... Any time outside of 
15:00 to 17:00 is fine. However, that 
place is extremely popular. Securing a 
reservation should be quite difficult—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So this time around, it's actually after 
their normal business hours!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
? ...Going into a shop after closing 
hours? Are we allowed in?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ They said it's a special exception 
for this time. I became friends with the 
owner on Umastagram, and after chatting a 
bunch—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I heard the place that inspired them 
during their patissier studies abroad was 
Flash-san's family shop! Isn't that 
amazing?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Was für eine Überraschung! So the Owner 
knows about me as well...?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ When I mentioned Flash-san was 
studying cake shops, they warmly invited 
us to come visit anytime!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Wh-Which means... we can actually ask the 
staff questions about the cakes and the 
shop itself...?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Of course♪ The owner said they wanted to 
chat too, so I'm sure you'll get to hear 
all sorts of things☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
What an unprecedented learning 
opportunity...! I give my thanks to this 
miraculous fate and to Curren-san! Let's 
decide on a meeting time for the day right 
away!
